description.value: 900 Degrees Bistro Sidney is the peninsula outpost of a Vancouver Island wood-fired Italian restaurant committed to fresh, organic ingredients with no frozen food, deep fryers, or microwaves. The menu extends well beyond pizza to include house-made pastas, wood-fired filet mignon, and escargots, giving Saanich Peninsula cyclists a sit-down meal that goes beyond typical roadside fare. It is the second location of a locally-owned operation run by chef-owner Adrian Ortiz-Mena.

The online menu lists Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten-Free pizza categories; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
